# Frontier Residences

> Boutique property management and short-term rental operator for luxury villas
> and apartments on the Costa del Sol (Marbella, Málaga) and in Austria
> (Vienna, Carinthia). We manage owners' homes end to end — listing, pricing,
> guests, housekeeping and reporting — or lease them outright for a fixed
> monthly rent. Guests book the same homes directly with us.

Frontier Residences Real Estate Management S.L. is registered in Málaga, Spain
(CIF ESB70848841, Registro Mercantil de Málaga, Tomo 6480, Folio 59, Hoja
MA-180653). Registered office: Calle Fresnos de Guadalmar 15, 29004 Málaga.
Contact: hello@frontier-residences.com.

## What we do

- **Full-service management** — we run the property and the owner earns what it
  earns, so income moves with the season and the market.
- **Guaranteed Income** — we lease the property from the owner and pay a fixed
  amount every month, booked or empty, and maintain the home throughout.
- **Renovations & interior design** — concept, construction, delivery, staging.
- **Investments** — sourcing and turnkey operation of rental properties.

Included in management: professional photography and staging, listings on
Airbnb, Booking.com and direct channels, all guest communication and check-in,
legal traveller registration, dynamic pricing, housekeeping, maintenance, and
owner reporting.

## Where we operate

- **Spain — Costa del Sol:** Marbella, Río Real, Los Flamingos, Calahonda,
  Fuengirola, Torremolinos, Málaga city.
- **Austria:** Vienna, and leisure property in Carinthia.

## For guests

Around two dozen villas, apartments and cabins are bookable directly. Rates are
dynamic and calculated per stay rather than fixed per night. Bookings are
confirmed by a person, check-in is self-service, and the team that looks after
the home is reachable at any hour of the stay.
